meta.title: Claude-mem session bridge
meta.description: Sends committed DSH user and assistant text to the local claude-mem worker, then adds project memories to new DSH sessions. Start the worker at http://127.0.0.1:37777. Only loopback HTTP URLs are allowed. Turns, project path, and session id stay on this computer; recalled memory is also sent to the DSH model provider. The bridge fails open when the worker is offline.
